item.title: Global wind farms are associated with land use dependent asymmetric warming and ecological changes
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 13 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04195-3

Wind farms increase nighttime temperatures and reduce vegetation productivity in a land-use-dependent manner, according to explainable machine learning and structural equation modeling of decades of observations from tens of thousands of wind farms worldwide.
